passive.name: Adaptive Defenses
passive.text: Basic attacks on champions grant a shield equal to a percentage of Camille's maximum health against their damage type (Physical or Magic) for a brief duration.

spells.name: Precision Protocol
spells.text: Camille's next attack deals bonus damage and grants bonus Move Speed. This spell can be recast for a short period of time, doing significantly increased bonus damage if Camille delays a period of time between the two attacks.

spells.name: Tactical Sweep
spells.text: Camille blasts in a cone after a delay, dealing damage. Enemies in the outer half are slowed and take extra damage, while also healing Camille.

spells.name: Hookshot
spells.text: Camille pulls herself to a wall, leaping off and knocking up enemy champions upon landing.

spells.name: The Hextech Ultimatum
spells.text: Camille dashes to target champion, anchoring them to the area. She also deals bonus magic damage to the target with her basic attacks.

damage.value: Camille deals sustained bonus magic damage with basic attacks against her R target.

archetype.value: Camille is a mobile bruiser who uses a shield, healing, and basic attacks to fight up close.

axis.value: Camille can take short trades with her passive shield and Q-empowered attacks.

winCondition.value: Camille wins by getting an early lead, snowballing, and carrying.

spikes.why: Camille can look for an early gank and start snowballing.
Camille gains a slow from W, improving her ganks.
Camille deals significantly increased bonus damage when she waits between Q attacks.

bait.why: Camille cannot use Hookshot to reach a wall and leap off again until its cooldown ends.

mistakes.value: Camille can fall behind if she fails to build an early lead.
Camille loses Q's significantly increased bonus damage by recasting before the required delay.
